record.question: The much doubted 'Mizoram Carbon Product Industry' is located at
record.explanation: Answer B: Luangmual. The Mizo Carbon Products unit was at Luangmual, Aizawl. The Union Ministry of MSME's original Aizawl industrial profile lists that company and location explicitly. This location evidence does not establish any corruption allegation implied by much doubted. Historical/source note: Establishes recorded unit location only; source's evaluative much-doubted wording is not a verified allegation. Reference: https://dcmsme.gov.in/dips/Aizawl.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
